tasks.title: Train Station
tasks.brief: A person enters a quiet train station and notices another person standing near a window. Design a single shot that clearly communicates who is looking at whom and where the two people are in relation to each other.

tasks.title: Museum
tasks.brief: A person enters a quiet museum gallery and notices another person standing near a tall window. Design a single shot that clearly communicates who is looking at whom and where the two people are in relation to each other.

tasks.title: Café
tasks.brief: Two people sit at a small café table. One of them is speaking; the other is listening. Design a single shot that shows which person is closer to the camera and how the two bodies relate across the table.

tasks.title: Bookstore
tasks.brief: Two people stand on opposite sides of a bookstore aisle. One of them is holding a book; the other is watching. Design a single shot that shows which person is closer to the camera and how the two bodies relate across the aisle.

tasks.title: Theater
tasks.brief: A person walks down a theater aisle toward someone who is already seated. Design a single shot that shows the walking person's movement and which way each person is facing.

tasks.title: Underground Station
tasks.brief: A person walks along an underground platform toward someone waiting near a pillar. Design a single shot that shows the walking person's movement and which way each person is facing.

tasks.title: Hallway
tasks.brief: A person stands close to the camera in a long hallway while another person appears farther down the corridor. Design a single shot that makes the near–far relationship and the space between them clear.

tasks.title: Gallery
tasks.brief: A person stands close to the camera in a long gallery while another person appears farther down the row of artworks. Design a single shot that makes the near–far relationship and the space between them clear.

tasks.title: Ferry Deck
tasks.brief: A person steps onto a ferry deck and suddenly notices someone standing by the railing. Describe the shot as clearly as possible.
